tagline.enUS: Slow stories about places, food and ideas
tagline.zhCN: 关于地方、美食与想法的慢故事

bio.enUS: Mei writes about travel and food, usually from a train.
bio.zhCN: 梅琳写旅行和美食，常常是在火车上写的。

bio.enUS: Tom builds small servers and writes down what he learns.
bio.zhCN: 汤姆搭建小型服务器，并记录所学。

bio.enUS: Aiko covers craft, print and the people who keep both going.
bio.zhCN: 爱子关注手工艺、印刷，以及让它们延续下去的人。

summary.enUS: Coffee, trams and an hour with nowhere to be.
summary.zhCN: 咖啡、电车，和一个无事可做的小时。

body.enUS:
The best part of a journey is rarely the arrival. It is the hour before, when the platform is quiet and the light has not decided what to do yet.

In short

We kept no schedule, and the days arranged themselves around meals, weather and whatever the person at the next table recommended.

Coffee, trams and an hour with nowhere to be.
body.zhCN:
旅途中最好的时刻很少是抵达，而是之前的那一个小时：站台安静，天光还没有拿定主意。

简而言之

我们没有安排行程，日子自己围着三餐、天气和邻桌的推荐转了起来。

咖啡、电车，和一个无事可做的小时。

title.enUS: The case for the long lunch

summary.enUS: Why the best meal of the day should not fit in a break.
summary.zhCN: 为什么一天中最好的一餐不该塞进休息时间。

body.enUS:
Good cooking is mostly patience with a little salt. The recipe matters less than paying attention to what is in the pan.

In short

Write down what you changed and why. A year from now that note will be the only recipe you really own.

Why the best meal of the day should not fit in a break.
body.zhCN:
好厨艺大半是耐心，再加一点盐。比起食谱，更重要的是留意锅里的变化。

简而言之

把改动和原因记下来。一年后，这张笔记才是你真正拥有的食谱。

为什么一天中最好的一餐不该塞进休息时间。

title.enUS: What a small server can do

summary.enUS: A page, a database and a pair of hands.
summary.zhCN: 一个页面、一个数据库，和一双手。

body.enUS:
A small server, a clear data model and a page that can be rebuilt from scratch: it is a dull recipe, and it is the one that keeps working.

In short

Keep what editors write apart from what developers write, and each side can change without asking the other for permission.

A page, a database and a pair of hands.
body.zhCN:
一台小服务器、清晰的数据模型、一个随时能重建的页面：这套做法乏味，但它能一直运转。

简而言之

把编辑写的内容和开发写的代码分开，双方都可以独立改动，不必互相请示。

一个页面、一个数据库，和一双手。

title.enUS: Ink, paper and the last print shop
title.zhCN: 纸与墨：最后一家印刷坊

summary.enUS: A press that is older than the street it stands on.
summary.zhCN: 一台比所在街道还要古老的印刷机。

body.enUS:
Some crafts survive because someone decided, quietly, that they were worth the trouble. Most of the time nobody notices until the shop is closed.

In short

Ask the people who still do it. They will tell you it is not nostalgia, just a better way to make the thing.

A press that is older than the street it stands on.
body.zhCN:
有些手艺能留下来，是因为有人悄悄认定它值得。大多数时候，要等店关了才有人注意到。

简而言之

去问问还在做的人。他们会说这不是怀旧，只是做这件东西更好的方式。

一台比所在街道还要古老的印刷机。
